name: patterns-choose-and-play
about: ENGINE.md §21 (D133; R90). Stopped, write on: kick steps 1 and 9 go into pattern 1 by keys; pattern + key 2 chooses pattern 2 at once (stopped), and keys put kick steps 5 and 13 there: the field is always the active pattern's. Pattern + key 1 goes back. Write off, then pattern held over the view at 5: the grid shows the patterns (field: the used ones, 1 and 2; stitch: the chain, pattern 1 alone; bar: the active one, pattern 1) and sounds=0. The play edit at 6 plays pattern 1 (ticks 576 and 1344); stopped at 22, pattern 2 chosen at 23 at once, played from 24 (ticks 2688 and 3456). Nothing waits: every choice here is made stopped.
